author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: a perfectly round rim with two short hooks, which read as a ball or winking face and lost the reference's wavy cell membrane. After: a softly wavy eight-lobed rim (cardinal lobes on the r20 lattice) and two dimple arcs bulging toward the upper left and lower right like the reference's marks; reads as a cell at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Membrane reduced to eight lobes (the reference has about ten) so the lattice peaks stay exact.
